title: The Perfume Taking Over Paris Fashion Week: Les Bains Guerbois
summary: Les Bains Guerbois turns Parisian nightlife history into fragrance. Here's why it's having a moment during Paris Fashion Week, plus three scents to try.
body_markdown:
Attempting to bottle the city of Paris and all its complexities is no small challenge. Paris is romantic and gritty, glamorous and eccentric all at once. But French perfume house[Les Bains Guerbois](https://www.scentbird.com/brand/les-bains-guerbois) comes remarkably close, which is exactly why its scents are turning up everywhere during[Paris Fashion Week](https://www.scentbird.com/blog/blog-fashion-week-beauty-trends-fragrances/) this season. Rather than creating fragrances that simply use French ingredients, the house draws on different eras, places, and characters from Parisian life to create scents that feel like little olfactory snapshots of the city.


## **A little about its history**


The story of Les Bains Guerbois begins in 1885, when Auguste Guerbois opened the original establishment as a luxurious bathhouse and spa. Over the years, it became a gathering place for some of Paris’ most prominent creative figures, including Claude Monet, Émile Zola, and Marcel Proust.


Nearly a century later, in 1978, the space was transformed into Les Bains Douches, becoming one of Paris’ most legendary nightlife destinations. Its guest list read like a who’s who of fashion, music, and culture, with Yves Saint Laurent, Kate Moss, Madonna, Serge Gainsbourg, and countless other artists and creatives passing through its doors.


In 2015, cinema producer and heir Jean-Pierre Marois reimagined the historic building once again, this time as a five-star boutique hotel. The story eventually expanded beyond the walls of the hotel: since 2016, Les Bains Guerbois has developed its own perfumery, translating the spirit and history of the place into fragrance. The result is a perfume house less interested in creating a single signature idea of Paris and more interested in exploring its many personalities. Each fragrance tells a different story, whether it evokes a particular decade, a night out, a neighborhood, or the people who have made the city what it is.


## **Scentbird picks**


If you’re looking to experience Les Bains Guerbois through fragrance, these are a few scents to start with:


### [LES BAINS GUERBOIS 1978 Les Bains Douches](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/les-bains-guerbois-1978-les-bains-douches-65354411516463)


Reminiscent of the iconic Parisian nightclub that kept its doors open from 1978 to 2010, Les Bains Douches is a reminder that the night is still young. It opens with yuzu and candied orange before unfolding into a heart of sweet davana. In the dry down, blond vanilla and tobacco melt sensually into the skin.


### [LES BAINS GUERBOIS 1979 New Wave](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/les-bains-guerbois-1979-new-wave-24388028470854)


This fragrance was heavily inspired by an era of creativity and innovation in the city. Unexpected from the very first spritz, 1979 New Wave opens with a cool hit of peppermint. Soon, iris takes over, grounding the fragrance. Finally, creamy sandalwood softens the edges, revealing a powdery side to the scent you might not have expected.


### [LES BAINS GUERBOIS 1992 Purple Night](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/les-bains-guerbois-1992-purple-night-137986876974029)


Purple Night is temptation in fragrance form. Tuberose, honey, and exotic florals give it an almost narcotic richness, mandarin adds a flash of brightness, and finally, patchouli deepens everything into something darker and more seductive.


Whether you gravitate toward something smoky and seductive or fresh and understated, Les Bains Guerbois offers a version of Paris to match.

## Frequently asked questions


### What is Les Bains Guerbois?


Les Bains Guerbois is a French perfume house rooted in the real history of a single Parisian address: an 1885 bathhouse frequented by Monet and Proust, later the legendary nightclub Les Bains Douches, and now a five-star hotel. Since 2016 it has translated that history into fragrance.


### What does Les Bains Guerbois 1978 Les Bains Douches smell like?


It opens with yuzu and candied orange, moves into sweet davana, and settles into blond vanilla and tobacco. It’s built to evoke a night out at the nightclub the scent is named for, warm and a little smoky rather than fresh or citrusy.


### What does Les Bains Guerbois 1979 New Wave smell like?


It opens with a sharp hit of peppermint, then iris takes over and grounds the scent, before creamy sandalwood softens everything into a powdery finish. It’s meant to capture the creative, unpredictable energy of Paris in the late 1970s.
